Its overwhelming heft will crush your foe, shield and all.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 54 |durability = 25 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Mighty Lynel Crusher}} Mighty Lynel Crushers are two-handed [[Weapon]]s wielded by [[Blue-Maned Lynel]]s in the [[Gerudo Highlands]] and [[Hebra Mountains]]. In [[Master Mode]], they are utilized by [[White-Maned Lynel]]s instead. They were made by [[Lynel]]s and reinforced to increase their durability and damage. Their origin makes them part of the [[Lynel Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of Weapons created by Lynels.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 174}} Their weight is capable of crushing both their opponents and their [[Shield]]s. Being made of metal, Mighty Lynel Crushers will attract [[Lightning]] when equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]] and conduct [[Electricity]], and they can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. However, they do not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They will also sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Lsword_017" |Life = 25 |Power = 54 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 6 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 12 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 5 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 13 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 23 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 6 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 12 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 0.7 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 45 |BuyingPrice = 99 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link Two-Handed Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Trivia== * Mighty Lynel Crushers are one of several [[Permanently Missable Items]] in {{BotW|-}}.
